name: kitex-speculative-decode-checkpoints-across-3754
instr:
Kitex cannot inspect remote.ByteBuffer input atomically and restore rejected or incomplete reads. Add bounded read checkpoints so codecs commit accepted interpretations and roll back others without changing decoded values, errors, byte accounting, connection reuse, or behavior without checkpoints.

Return exact terminal consumption or restoration results. Reject repeated finalization with ErrCheckpointFinalized. Enforce last-opened-first finalization with ErrCheckpointOrder without changing the cursor or checkpoint state. Enforce replay limits before irreversible consumption. ErrCheckpointLimit must lose no readable input and allow complete rollback of earlier reads.

Give the default in-memory, bufiox, go-net, netpoll, and HTTP/2 backends equivalent semantics while preserving cursor, accounting, zero-copy, framing, pooling, and ownership rules. A bufiox checkpoint that cannot guarantee restoration must return ErrCheckpointUnsupported before inspecting input, without panicking or corrupting input. Release must invalidate active handles with ErrCheckpointReleased and prevent retained bytes or borrowed slices from escaping into reuse.

Protocol detection and TTHeader, mesh-header, gRPC, and protobuf decoding must commit only accepted frames. Otherwise restore all inspected framing, metadata, and available body bytes without replacing the established decoder error.
